from qiskit import QuantumCircuit


def solve() -> QuantumCircuit:
    qc = QuantumCircuit(2)
    # |00> --H0--> (|00>+|01>)/sqrt2
    qc.h(0)
    # flip qubit 1 to get odd parity
    qc.x(1)
    # |10> + |11>  ->  CNOT 0->1  ->  |10> + |01>
    qc.cx(0, 1)

    return qc
